sound_theme.description: The sound theme used for sound events (e.g., 'freedesktop', 'hicolor')

allow_important.description: List of applications allowed to override feedback level (e.g., 'alarm-clock.desktop')

prefer_flash.description: Prefer camera flash over status LED for visual feedback

theme.description: Feedback theme name to override auto-detection (empty = auto)

max_haptic_strength.description: Maximum haptic motor strength, clamped to [0.0, 1.0]
